assets.prompt: Create ONE isolated 2D anime explosion VFX sprite on transparent background for a fantasy game. Reference image defines the dramatic silhouette and cel shading: colossal upward erupting fireball with overlapping billowing rounded smoke lobes, pointed flame tongues shooting upward and outward, dark heavy burnt-brown ink contours around orange outer flames, bright golden yellow inner clouds and almost white hot central base. Wide grounded base and towering upper eruption, asymmetric organic hand-drawn lobes. Readable powerful anime detonation, crisp cel animation painted shapes, not a round magic orb, not thin radial laser beams. Fully show entire explosion with transparent padding, no ground, no city, no buildings, no characters, no words, no watermark, no frame. Use the reference only for explosion shape and visual language; exclude everything else. Square canvas, explosion fills 85% canvas.

assets.prompt: Wide landscape 16:9 pop-art manga victory background illustration for SPIRIT BOMB fantasy board game, no text. A colossal radiant spirit-energy sphere hovers over rugged Spirit Mountain peaks, four elemental streams fire water earth wind spiral upward to it. Dynamic powerful comic explosion-cloud silhouette behind the mountain, huge sweeping energy curves. Composition: main mountain and orb occupy central LEFT 65% area; keep upper-left corner relatively simple for a title, bottom quarter simple for caption, RIGHT third low detail because character portrait overlays it. Entire image is dramatic screen-printed art with bold thick dark navy ink shapes, flat turquoise teal pale cyan cream limited palette, handmade rough ink edges and coarse halftone shading. No rainbow colors, no smooth photographic gradients, no shiny 3D render, no buildings, no characters, no text, no logos, no borders. Large clear illustrative mountain and huge spirit energy ball, highly legible silhouette. Full bleed illustration, landscape wide format.
